inspiration: Profession tree: the format defines professions, a profession list, categories, recipes and materials as nested structures (src/v67.hpp, struct names at lines 62-131). Recreate: a crafting browser that goes profession, then category, then recipe.

Material slots with levels: a recipe holds up to eight material slots, and each slot has a base material, a skill requirement and a material level (src/v67.hpp near lines 62-80). Recreate: a fixed slot count per recipe with level gates, so tiers are data, not new code.

Base material list: a named base-material list drives the material tiers (src/v67.hpp near line 39). Recreate: a short list of our own base materials with a level rank each, shared across all recipes.

Separate craft record and material entries: the format keeps a craft record (craft_t, line 131) apart from its material entries (craftmaterial_t, line 124). Recreate: a small record-plus-entries split for our own crafting data, if it suits our item system (struct names only were read).

Multiple output modes: one extract step can write CSV, JSON, SQLite or plain text (README; src/defines.hpp output_mode enum). Recreate: one recipe dump to several formats, so designers and tools can read the same data.
